description: This is a C# source file defining a Program class that sets up and runs various benchmarks related to MapReduce, Transactions, Ping, Grain Storage, and other performance tests within the Benchmarks namespace. It includes a dictionary of benchmark actions, a Main method to execute selected benchmarks, and a helper method for running benchmarks with timing and cleanup.
